name: StackWarp
impact: Admin-privileged attacker uses an undocumented CPU MSR to corrupt the guest stack pointer, deterministically breaking SEV-SNP control-flow integrity
mitigation: AMD microcode updates for affected parts (Milan, Genoa, Turin) per AMD-SB-3027
boundary_statement: StackWarp (CVE-2025-29943, AMD-SB-3027, USENIX Security 2026) manipulates an SEV-SNP guest's stack pointer via an undocumented MSR, breaking integrity. AMD rates it Low (CVSS 3.1 3.2 / 4.0 4.6); microcode fixes target Milan, Genoa and Turin.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: AMD-SB-3027 'SEV-SNP Guest Stack Pointer Corruption Vulnerability': CVE-2025-29943, CVSS 3.2 (Low), 'an admin-privileged attacker to modify the configuration of the CPU pipeline, potentially resulting in the corruption of the stack pointer inside an SEV-SNP guest'.
